scenes.text: The Sun heats oceans and lakes, and water evaporates.
The vapor rises, cools and condenses into clouds.
Droplets grow heavy and fall as rain or snow.
Rivers and groundwater carry it back to the sea.

steps.label: Evaporation
steps.detail: Sunlight turns surface water into vapor.

steps.label: Condensation
steps.detail: Rising vapor cools into cloud droplets.

steps.label: Precipitation
steps.detail: Heavy droplets fall as rain or snow.

steps.label: Collection
steps.detail: Runoff returns water to oceans and lakes.
